thread:
sophie: Quick decision needed: what should be default onprem package for new customers? Options: minimal-agent, managed-distro, proxy-hybrid. Need a single default for GA.
enrique: minimal-agent -> least friction for netops, better for air-gapped installs.
drew: managed-distro -> easier for support and observability, but bigger footprint and more legal/KMS work.
Tam: field notes: 3 customers demand minimal-agent due to strict egress. 1 wants managed-distro for simplified ops.
sophie: key concern is upgrade path. customers want move-from-minimal->managed without reinstall. Is operator shim realistic?
enrique: yes, operator shim would inject components and update routing via CRs. 2-3 sprints add plus testing. Must include static IP preservation.
drew: also add migration playbook and a rollback plan. If we default to minimal, we should make opt-in managed-distro seamless.
sophie: proposal: default minimal-agent for GA, publish operator-shim roadmap and migration checklist, and bill managed-distro as an add-on SLA.
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://intranet.redwood/rfcs/onprem-packaging-defaults-1799990001 — comment by 2025-09-01
Tam: sounds good. I'll collect pilot customer contacts and constraints.
sophie: thanks — eng to draft AD + migration cmds by end of week.
